nom: Clinique Take The Day Off Charcoal Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the balm cleanses without leaving a greasy residue and several say it works better for them than the original formula, though one felt it made oily skin feel oily and recommends it only for oily, not dry, skin.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry-cracked skin found the black tint sinks into and stains dry skin on hands, and another with dry-combo skin (oily t-zone) found it did not feel stripping; a critical reviewer says the charcoal version will strip and dry out the skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (including combo-oily-to-normal and dry-combo with oily t-zone) report it cleanses well, removes makeup without greasy residue, and leaves skin feeling clean and hydrated.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and calmed breakouts, while others report eye burning, itching/burning, strange smell, and pimple-like breakouts after only a couple of uses.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her mid-30s who says most products dry out her face reports this one did not make her skin dry and felt effective and gentle.

concerns.aging: One reviewer uses it as the first step of an anti-aging routine and finds it gentle and effective, though she cannot confirm any detoxifying claim.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness say the balm leaves skin feeling soft, hydrated, and not stripped, including one who called it non-drying despite her skin normally reacting badly to products; the critical minority says it strips and dries out skin.
concerns.redness: No reviews specifically discuss redness as a concern.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe burning, itching, or stinging on the skin or around the eyes after use, while a larger number describe it as gentle and non-irritating even on eyes.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports clogged pores and blackheads disappearing and pores looking smaller with continued use; another notes it pulls oil and debris from deep in the pores.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin say it calmed breakouts and felt refreshing without over-drying, but one reviewer reports the charcoal caused a purging effect with new pimple-like bumps, and another warns charcoal formulas can purge and trigger cystic acne.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple oily-skin reviewers say the balm leaves skin feeling clean and less oily through the day without a greasy film, though one reviewer found it made her feel oily compared to expectations and preferred it removed for dry skin types only.

aspects.libelle: Messy, gets under nails and cuticles
Hard to tell if eye makeup fully removed
High price for a basic balm
Struggles with waterproof mascara vs original

extraits.titre: Worst clinique product - Have been using clinique for years
extraits.texte: I have been using cliniqe products for several years now so trusted that this charcoal take the day off cleansing balm would be good too. I have sensitive skin and was excited to see a charcoal based product, on the first day I used this - the smell was strange but I still tried it on. The next day I used it again, and since just the 2nd use my skin broke out like crazy - I never never never get pimple like bumps ever. It has been several days since I stopped using this after only the 2 times and still am dealing with the awful pimple like bumps. The smell is awful and so is the product. I am now dealing with skin problems and wasted money on this product which I will never use again, and now I have to find something and spend more money to reverse the side effects of this product. I really wanted to like this, but this product is terrible.

This did what it's supposed to do. Wasn't the type of charcoal to stain your face which is great. Easy to use and very nice product, although if you struggle with acne this won't be your friend. Anything with charcoal will purge the skin. As someone Using acne fighting products 24/7 to minimize my breakouts and cystic acne , I don't want something that's going to bring them to the surface every time I take my make up off and new dark spots to fight off.

I wasn't looking for this take the day off balm but tried it after I received it in my Ipsy bag. I am pleasantly surprised how soft and refreshed my broken out skin feels. My hard to remove eye liner and eyeshadow came right off really using it with my make up eraser. Usually the makeup eraser cloth doesn't remove all my eye make up on its own. My skin is very sensitive, oily and acne prone but it's helped to calm my break out without over drying it.
I absolutely love this balm, it took off ALL of my makeup and left my skin clean. I have dry-combo skin (oily t-zone) and this did not make me feel stripped. I would recommend this.

I recieved the sample Charcoal 'Take the day off' cleansing balm and I honestly didn't expect to like it because the regular one didnt work for my skin and (now as a 36 yr old) most things make my face feel dry— even when it advertises that it wont. I am so happy I got to try the charcoal version because it's exactly what I've been looking for. This product doesnt make my face dry at all, and its effective AND gentle. I love it and I highly recommend!

It's a cleansing balm for skin types 2, 3 and 4. I don't understand why there's Japanese charcoal in here. Does that make the product sound fancier? Maybe it's a marketing ploy but it will absolutely strip your skin and dry it out. It is super pricey for a basic cleansing balm that may be in contact with skin for 53 seconds straight before it gets washed off, totally unnecessary to spend this much if you ask me. There is nothing in here that would warrant the ridiculous price-tag.

My skin has never looked so good! I've been using this for a couple weeks and I have seen a dramatic change in my skin. Clogged pores and blackheads are gone! My skin is so soft and clear it's unreal. After rinsing the charcoal balm I use the acne solutions cleansing bar, then apply even better brightening essence lotion and dramatically different moisturizer. My skin looks better without makeup than it does with it now. I'm sold!
